textos.Várias reviews criticam a forma como o f: Several reviews criticize the way the film portrays the teacher-student relationship as an apology for psychological and physical violence, normalizing sadism and humiliation in the name of artistic excellence.
textos.Muitos espectadores consideram o protago: Many viewers consider the protagonist and the mentor irritating, selfish and one-dimensional figures whose motivations sound false or exaggerated, making any empathy difficult.
textos.A narrativa é percebida como monótona e: The narrative is perceived as monotonous and repetitive, focused excessively on rehearsals and suffering, which generates anxiety and boredom instead of engagement.
textos.As reviews apontam que o filme reforça t: Reviews point out that the film reinforces tropes such as the suffering artist and the idea that greatness justifies abuse, without offering a deeper critique or reflection.
textos.Alguns espectadores familiarizados com j: Some viewers familiar with jazz criticize the fanciful, Hollywood-style representation of the music world, reducing the practice to a ritual of humiliation and suffering.
textos.Diversas pessoas relatam que a obra não: Several people report that the work does not live up to the acclaim it received, feeling disappointed after so much praise and considering the result overrated.
textos.As atuações de Miles Teller e J.K. Simmo: The performances of Miles Teller and J.K. Simmons are frequently praised, with emphasis on the intensity and the ability of the actor playing the instructor to switch between fury and false warmth.
textos.A tensão constante e o ritmo acelerado,: The constant tension and fast pace, especially in the rehearsal and performance scenes, are recognized as strengths that hold the attention.

textos.O instrutor é descrito como cruel, abusi: The instructor is described as cruel, abusive and psychologically violent, raising questions about the limits of teaching and the legitimacy of extreme methods.
textos.A direção, a edição e a fotografia são e: The direction, editing and cinematography are praised for their efficiency in conveying intensity and physical effort, although some consider the style excessively technical.
textos.Críticas apontam que a trama se torna re: Critics point out that the plot becomes repetitive, with predictable cycles of pressure and humiliation, and that the characters lack depth.
textos.A mensagem sobre a busca pela excelência: The message about the pursuit of excellence at any cost is seen as problematic, glorifying abuse and leaving a negative impression.
textos.As reviews positivas elogiam as atuações: Positive reviews praise the performances, especially J.K. Simmons's, considered intense and realistic, and Miles Teller's, which also stands out.
textos.Obsessão e busca pela perfeição: Obsession and the pursuit of perfection
textos.O filme é visto como um retrato da obses: The film is seen as a portrait of obsession and the desire to reach perfection, showing the consequences of this behavior in the protagonist's life.
textos.Muitas reviews destacam a tensão constan: Many reviews highlight the film's constant tension and intensity, which keeps the viewer nervous and engaged from start to finish.
textos.As reviews elogiam a forma como o filme: Reviews praise the way the film portrays the world of jazz and the music industry, including its behind-the-scenes and challenges.
textos.A dinâmica entre o professor e o aluno é: The dynamic between the teacher and the student is often mentioned, with emphasis on the abusive methods and the psychological manipulation exerted by the mentor.
textos.O desfecho do filme é amplamente elogiad: The film's ending is widely praised for its power and execution, being considered one of the work's high points.

textos.Lançado em 2014 sob a direção de Damien: Released in 2014 and directed by Damien Chazelle, Whiplash is a musical drama and thriller that follows Andrew in his goal of becoming the best drummer of his generation. The young man catches the eye of the ruthless jazz master Terence Fletcher, who oversteps limits and turns this dedication into an obsession that puts his physical and mental health at risk.
textos.A experiência cinematográfica é pautada: The cinematic experience is driven by an atmosphere of continuous tension and a rhythm of constant intensity. The setting and the dramatic structure establish a tone of rigor and permanent friction in the space of the music rehearsals.
textos.Os três grupos concordam sobre o que o f: The three groups agree on what the film is and disagree on whether it works, converging on themes and diverging in the verdict. In the vast majority of ratings (~93%), a significant share stress the striking performances, while a good portion emphasize the portrayal of obsession and the pursuit of perfection. In this same group, several highlight the tension and intensity that permeate the narrative.
textos.Para quem está nessa faixa, numa fração: For those in this range, in a minimal fraction of the ratings (~6%), many acknowledge the impact of the performances and a considerable number note the pace and tension, although a smaller slice voice reservations about the instructor character and his teaching methods.
textos.Já sob a leitura presente numa fração ai: In the reading found in an even smaller fraction of the ratings (~1%), most reject the romanticization of abuse and toxicity, a good portion are bothered by unpleasant characters without depth, and several point to a drawn-out pace that results in an anguishing experience.
